requirements.text: POST /orders accepts customerId and one or more lines, each containing sku and positive quantity.
The service rejects a line with an unknown SKU or a zero or negative quantity.
A successful request creates an order with status CREATED, calculates the line-total sum, and emits order.created with the new order identifier.

source_context.text: Manager approval and retention period are unspecified and are not requirements.
The supplied implementation validates the customer and lines, persists a CREATED order, publishes OrderCreated, and has no approval or retention branch.

warnings: Manager approval, retention period, and other authorization requirements are absent from the supplied inputs and were not inferred.
